description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token with flying and vigilance due to Divine Visitation..
When the Angel enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.
